```{r import data}
# case data
measles_data_imp <- read.csv(here("data/measles_data.csv")
)

measles_data <- measles_data_imp %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  dplyr::select(-c(1:2, 6, 7, 9, 10, 18:20, 23, 25, 30, 32, 38, 40, 41, 42, 53, 58, 59, 69, 70, 73, 73,  90, 97:103)) %>% 
  mutate(
    camp = if_else(
      camp == "other",
      specify_other_camp,
      camp
    )
  ) %>% 
  dplyr::select(-specify_other_camp) %>% 
  mutate(
    block = str_remove(block, "^block_"),
    camp = str_replace(camp, "^camp_", "Camp ")
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    camp = if_else(
      camp == "KTP Register Camp", "Kutupalong RC",
      camp
    )
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    camp = case_when(
      camp %in% c("Camp 1", "Camp 8") ~ paste0(camp, "E"),
      TRUE ~ camp
    )
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    date_of_visit = as.Date(date_of_visit, format = "%d/%m/%Y")
  ) %>% 
  mutate(block = stringr::str_to_sentence(block))

measles_data <- measles_data %>% 
  mutate(ipd_opd = case_when(patient_id == "n/a" ~ "OPD",
                             TRUE ~ "IPD"))

#map data
sub_blocks <- st_read(here("data/Block_Boundary_V1/Block_Boundary_V1.shp"), quiet = TRUE) %>% 
  filter(!CampName_1 %in% c("Camp 21", "Camp 22", "Camp 24", "Camp 25", "Camp 26", "Camp 27", "Nayapara RC")) %>% 
  mutate(CampName_1 = str_remove(CampName_1, " Extension$"))

#merge datasets
cases_sf <- measles_data %>%
  left_join(
    sub_blocks,
    by = c("camp" = "CampName_1",
           "block" = "BlockLabel"
           )
  ) %>%
  st_as_sf()

# points for map
cases_points <- cases_sf %>%
  filter(!is.na(District)) %>% 
  mutate(
    geometry = map(
      geometry,
      ~ st_sample(.x, size = 1) %>% st_cast("POINT")
    )
  ) %>%
  unnest(geometry) %>%
  st_as_sf() %>%
  st_set_crs(st_crs(sub_blocks))

camp_boundaries <- sub_blocks %>%
  group_by(CampName_1) %>%
  summarise(
    geometry = sf::st_union(geometry),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

epi_cases <- measles_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(date_of_visit)) %>% 
  arrange(date_of_visit) %>%
  group_by(date_of_visit) %>%
  mutate(
    case_id = row_number(),
    hover_text = paste0(
      "Sex: ", gender, "<br>",
      "Age: ", age_in_years, " years<br>"
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r calculate numbers}
# Total cases
total_cases <- nrow(measles_data)

# Severe cases
severe_cases <- measles_data %>%
  filter(ipd_opd == "IPD") %>%
  nrow()

# Simple cases
simple_cases <- measles_data %>%
  filter(ipd_opd == "OPD") %>%
  nrow()

# Weekly cases (last 7 days)
weekly_cases <- measles_data %>%
  filter(date_of_visit >= Sys.Date() - 7) %>%
  nrow()

# Weekly severe cases
weekly_severe_cases <- measles_data %>%
  filter(date_of_visit >= Sys.Date() - 7,
         ipd_opd == "IPD") %>%
  nrow()

# Weekly simple cases
weekly_simple_cases <- measles_data %>%
  filter(date_of_visit >= Sys.Date() - 7,
         ipd_opd == "OPD") %>%
  nrow()

# Yesterday's cases
yesterdays_cases <- measles_data %>%
  filter(date_of_visit == Sys.Date() - 1) %>%
  nrow()

# Yesterday's severe cases
yesterdays_severe_cases <- measles_data %>%
  filter(date_of_visit == Sys.Date() - 1,
         ipd_opd == "IPD") %>%
  nrow()

# Yesterday's simple cases
yesterdays_simple_cases <- measles_data %>%
  filter(date_of_visit == Sys.Date() - 1,
         ipd_opd == "OPD") %>%
  nrow()
```

```{r}
    patient_id == "n/a"
  ) %>%
```

# Indicators 
```{r indicators}
# Start and end date of surveillance and total days surveilled
surv_start <- min(measles_data$date_of_visit, na.rm = TRUE)
surv_end   <- max(measles_data$date_of_visit, na.rm = TRUE)
surv_days  <- as.integer(difftime(surv_end, surv_start, units = "days")) + 1

# total number of Cases 
N_total <- nrow(measles_data)
N_cases_u5 <- measles_data %>% 
  filter(age_in_years < 5) %>% 
  nrow()
# number of OPD cases(includes NAs)

#Number of discharged, LAMA as outcome (IPD)
N_discharge <- sum(measles_data$outcome == "discharged", na.rm = TRUE)
N_LAMA      <- sum(measles_data$outcome == "lama", na.rm = TRUE)


pct_discharge <- round(N_discharge / N_total * 100, 1)
pct_LAMA      <- round(N_LAMA / N_total * 100, 1)

# camp of origin (all cases)
N_JMS <- measles_data %>%
  filter(phc == "new_jms") %>%
  nrow()

N_HMS <- measles_data %>%
  filter(phc == "hms") %>%
  nrow()
O_JMS <- measles_data %>%
  filter(phc == "old_jms") %>%
  nrow()

#Total Population (at risk) = FDMN All camp <5 year age
pop_at_risk <- 184858

# Overall Attack Rate (/1,000) 
#1st calculate cases amongst population at risk (FDMN)
N_total_fdmn <- measles_data %>%
  filter(nationality == "fdmn") %>%
  nrow()
#2nd calculate attack rate
attack_rate <- round(N_total_fdmn / pop_at_risk * 1000, 2)
#Overall Incidence Rate (/10k/day)
incidence_rate <- round(N_total_fdmn / pop_at_risk * 10000 / surv_days, 3)

# Severe cases (N and %), 
N_severe <- sum(measles_data$clinical_severity == "severe", na.rm = TRUE)
severe_rate <- round(N_severe / N_total * 100, 2)

# deaths and mortality rate (total and in under 5)
N_deaths    <- sum(measles_data$outcome == "died", na.rm = TRUE)
#Case fatality
cfr <- round(N_deaths / N_total * 100, 2)
deaths_u5 <- measles_data %>%
  filter(outcome == "died", age_in_years < 5) %>%
  nrow()
cfr_u5 <- round(deaths_u5 / N_cases_u5 * 100, 2)

#Vaccination 
N_vaccinated <- sum(measles_data$did_the_patient_receive_measle == "yes", na.rm = TRUE)
vacc_coverage <- round(N_vaccinated / N_total * 100, 1)

#nationality of patients (N and %)
fdmn <- sum(measles_data$nationality == "fdmn", na.rm = TRUE)
host <- sum(measles_data$nationality == "host", na.rm = TRUE)

fdmn_pct <- round(fdmn / N_total * 100, 2)
host_pct <- round(host / N_total * 100, 2)

#age  (total)
age_prop <- measles_data %>%
  mutate(
    age_group = case_when(
      age_in_years < 1 ~ "<1 year",
      age_in_years < 5 ~ "1–4 years",
      age_in_years < 15 ~ "5–14 years",
      TRUE ~ "15+ years"
    )
  ) %>%
  count(age_group) %>%
  mutate(pct = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 1))
age_text <- age_prop %>%
  filter(age_group != "15+ years") %>%
  mutate(txt = paste0(pct, "% are ", age_group)) %>%
  pull(txt) %>%
  paste(collapse = "; ")
#age  (IPD)
age_prop_ipd <- measles_data %>%
  filter(does_this_patient_admitted_and == "yes") %>% 
  mutate(
    age_group = case_when(
      age_in_years < 1 ~ "<1 year",
      age_in_years < 5 ~ "1–4 years",
      age_in_years < 15 ~ "5–14 years",
      TRUE ~ "15+ years"
    )
  ) %>%
  count(age_group) %>%
  mutate(pct = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 1))
age_text_ipd <- age_prop_ipd %>%
  filter(age_group != "15+ years") %>%
  mutate(txt = paste0(pct, "% are ", age_group)) %>%
  pull(txt) %>%
  paste(collapse = "; ")


#pneumonia amongst ipd 
ipd <- measles_data %>% filter(does_this_patient_admitted_and == "yes")
pneumonia_ipd <- sum(
  ipd$pneumonia == TRUE,
  na.rm = TRUE
)
pct_pneumonia_ipd <- round(pneumonia_ipd / N_IPD * 100, 1)

#Complications in IPD
complications_ipd <- ipd %>%
  dplyr::select(starts_with("complications_")) %>%
  mutate(across(
    everything(),
    ~ .x %in% c(TRUE, "TRUE", "true")
  ))

complication_prop <- complications_ipd %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), ~ sum(.x, na.rm = TRUE))) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = everything(),
    names_to = "complication",
    values_to = "n"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    complication = str_remove(complication, "^complications_"),
    pct = round(n / N_IPD * 100, 1)
  )

complication_text <- complication_prop %>%
  mutate(
    txt = paste0(
      str_to_title(complication),
      ": ",
      pct,
      "%"
    )
  ) %>%
  pull(txt) %>%
  paste(collapse = "; ")

DENOMINATOR <- N_total

OPD_pct <-round(N_OPD / N_total * 100, 2)
IPD_pct <-round(N_IPD / N_total * 100, 2)
```

```{r second indicator table}
#| title: "Surveillance Overview"

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Define indicator labels (ASCII-safe, fixed length = 22)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------

indicators <- c(
  "Discharged - N (%)",
  "LAMA - N (%)",
  "Died - N (%)",

  "New JMS cases",
  "Old JMS cases",
  "HMS cases",

  "Total population denominator (Under-5 FDMN, all camps)",
  "Overall attack rate (/1,000)",
  "Overall incidence rate (/10,000 pop-day)",

  "Deaths - N (overall)",
  "Case fatality rate - overall (%)",

  "Deaths <5 years - N",
  "Case fatality rate - <5 years (%)",

  "Vaccinated - N",
  "Vaccination coverage (%)",

  "Unvaccinated - N (%)",

  "FDMN (Rohingya) - N (%)",
  "Host (Bangladeshi) - N (%)",

  "SAM - N (<5y, MUAC <11.5 cm)",
  "MAM - N (<5y, MUAC 11.5-12.4)"
)


add_section <- function(title) {
  tibble(
    Indicator    = title,
    N    = NA,
    Denominator  = NA,
    `Rate / %`   = NA
  )
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Build the surveillance overview table
# ------------------------------------------------------------------

surveillance_overview <- tibble(
  Indicator = indicators,
  N = c(
    N_discharge,
    N_LAMA,
    N_deaths,

    N_JMS,
    O_JMS,
    N_HMS,

    pop_at_risk,
    N_total,
    N_total,

    N_deaths,
    N_deaths,

    deaths_u5,
    deaths_u5,

    N_vaccinated,
    N_vaccinated,

    N_total - N_vaccinated,

    fdmn,
    host,

    sam$final_diagnoses_severe_acute_malnutrition,
    mam$final_diagnoses_moderate_acute_malnutrition
  ),

  Denominator = c(
    N_total,
    N_total,
    N_total,

    N_total,
    N_total,
    N_total,

    NA,
    pop_at_risk,
    pop_at_risk * surv_days,
#Deaths
    NA,
    N_total,
#Deaths under 5
    N_cases_u5,
    N_cases_u5,

    NA,
    N_total,

    N_total,

    N_total,
    N_total,

    sam$total,
    mam$total
  ),

  `Rate / %` = c(
    round(N_discharge / N_total * 100, 1),
    round(N_LAMA / N_total * 100, 1),
    round(N_deaths / N_total * 100, 1),

    round(N_JMS / N_total * 100, 1),
    round(O_JMS / N_total * 100, 1),
    round(N_HMS / N_total * 100, 1),

    NA,
    attack_rate,
    incidence_rate,

    NA,
    cfr,

    NA,
    cfr_u5,

    NA,
    vacc_coverage,

    round((N_total - N_vaccinated) / N_total * 100, 1),

    round(fdmn / N_total * 100, 1),
    round(host / N_total * 100, 1),

    round(
      sam$final_diagnoses_severe_acute_malnutrition / sam$total * 100, 1
    ),
    round(
      mam$final_diagnoses_moderate_acute_malnutrition / mam$total * 100, 1
    )
  )
)


surveillance_overview_clean <- surveillance_overview %>%
  filter(
    !Indicator %in% c(
      "Severe cases - N",
      "Severe rate (%)"
    )
  )

surveillance_overview_final <- bind_rows(
  add_section("CLINICAL OUTCOMES"),
  surveillance_overview_clean %>% slice(1:3),

  add_section("CASE CLASSIFICATION"),
  surveillance_overview_clean %>% slice(4:6),

  add_section("POPULATION & INCIDENCE"),
  surveillance_overview_clean %>% slice(7:9),

  add_section("MORTALITY"),
  surveillance_overview_clean %>% slice(10:13),

  add_section("VACCINATION STATUS"),
  surveillance_overview_clean %>% slice(14:16),

  add_section("NATIONALITY"),
  surveillance_overview_clean %>% slice(17:18),

  add_section("NUTRITION STATUS (<5 YEARS)"),
  surveillance_overview_clean %>% slice(19:n())
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Create a formatted flextable (SECTION 1 style)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------

surveillance_ft <- flextable::flextable(surveillance_overview_final) |>
  
  # ----- Header labels -----
  flextable::set_header_labels(
    Indicator   = "SECTION 1 - SURVEILLANCE OVERVIEW",
    N           = "N",
    Denominator = "Denominator",
    `Rate / %`  = "%"
  ) |>
  
  # ----- Center headers -----
  flextable::align(
    align = "center",
    part = "header"
  ) |>
  
  # ----- Center numeric columns -----
  flextable::align(
    j = c("N", "Denominator", "Rate / %"),
    align = "center",
    part = "body"
  ) |>
  
  # ----- Left-align indicator text -----
  flextable::align(
    j = "Indicator",
    align = "left",
    part = "body"
  ) |>
  
  # ----- Bold column headers -----
  flextable::bold(part = "header") |>
  
  # ----- Bold SECTION headers (rows created via add_section) -----
  flextable::bold(
    i = is.na(surveillance_overview_final$N),
    part = "body"
  ) |>
  
  flextable::fontsize(size = 10, part = "all") |>
  flextable::autofit()
surveillance_ft

```


```{r second tab}
#| title: "% of age groups (OPD and IPD)"
#| fig.asp: 1
#| out.width: 100%
#| fig.align: center
#| fig.margin: 0

# Severe IPD cases by age group
age_severe_ipd <- measles_data |>
  filter(
    does_this_patient_admitted_and == "yes",
    clinical_severity == "severe"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    age_group = case_when(
      age_in_years < 1  ~ "<1 year",
      age_in_years < 5  ~ "1–4 years",
      age_in_years < 15 ~ "5–14 years",
      TRUE              ~ "≥15 years"
    )
  ) |>
  count(age_group, name = "Severe_IPD_N")


# ---------- Prepare OPD age distribution ----------
age_prop_opd <- measles_data |>
  filter(does_this_patient_admitted_and %in% c("no", "n/a")) |>
  mutate(
    age_group = case_when(
      age_in_years < 1  ~ "<1 year",
      age_in_years < 5  ~ "1–4 years",
      age_in_years < 15 ~ "5–14 years"
    )
  ) |>
  count(age_group, name = "OPD_N")

# ---------- Prepare IPD age distribution (reuse logic) ----------
age_prop_ipd_full <- measles_data |>
  filter(does_this_patient_admitted_and == "yes") |>
  mutate(
    age_group = case_when(
      age_in_years < 1  ~ "<1 year",
      age_in_years < 5  ~ "1–4 years",
      age_in_years < 15 ~ "5–14 years"
    )
  ) |>
  count(age_group, name = "IPD_N")

# ---------- Combine ALL / OPD / IPD ----------
age_section2 <- age_prop |>
  rename(N_all = n) |>
  left_join(age_prop_opd, by = "age_group") |>
  left_join(age_prop_ipd_full, by = "age_group") |>
  filter(age_group != "15+ years") |>
  mutate(
    OPD_N = tidyr::replace_na(OPD_N, 0),
    IPD_N = tidyr::replace_na(IPD_N, 0),
    Denominator = N_total,
    `% Total`   = round(N_all / N_total * 100, 2)
  )

# ---------- UNDER‑5 TOTAL row ----------
under5_row <- age_section2 |>
  filter(age_group %in% c("<1 year", "1–4 years")) |>
  summarise(
    age_group   = "UNDER 5 TOTAL (<5 years)",
    N_all       = sum(N_all),
    Denominator = N_total,
    `% Total`   = round(N_all / N_total * 100, 2),
    OPD_N       = sum(OPD_N),
    IPD_N       = sum(IPD_N)
  )

age_section2_final <- bind_rows(age_section2, under5_row)
age_section2_final <- age_section2_final |>
  left_join(age_severe_ipd, by = "age_group") |>
  mutate(
    Severe_IPD_N = tidyr::replace_na(Severe_IPD_N, 0),

    `% of IPD` = round(IPD_N / N_IPD * 100, 2),

    `Severe %` = round(
      ifelse(IPD_N > 0, Severe_IPD_N / IPD_N * 100, NA),
      2
    )
  )


age_section2_final <- age_section2_final |>
  dplyr::select(
    age_group,
    N_all,
    Denominator,
    `% Total`,
    OPD_N,
    IPD_N,
    `% of IPD`,
    Severe_IPD_N,
    `Severe %`
  )
age_ft <- flextable::flextable(age_section2_final) |>

  flextable::set_header_labels(
    age_group    = "Age Group",
    N_all        = "N (All)",
    Denominator  = "Denominator",
    `% Total`    = "% Total",
    OPD_N        = "OPD (N)",
    IPD_N        = "IPD (N)",
    `% of IPD`   = "% IPD",
    Severe_IPD_N = "Severe IPD (N)",
    `Severe %`   = "% Severe IPD"
  ) |>

  flextable::align(align = "center", part = "header") |>
  flextable::align(
    j = c("N_all", "Denominator",
          "% Total", "OPD_N", "IPD_N",
          "% of IPD", "Severe_IPD_N", "Severe %"),
    align = "center",
    part = "body"
  ) |>
  flextable::align(j = "age_group", align = "left", part = "body") |>
  flextable::bold(part = "header") |>
  flextable::bold(
    i = age_section2_final$age_group == "UNDER 5 TOTAL (<5 years)",
    part = "body"
  ) |>
  # ✅ Vertical line BEFORE OPD
  flextable::vline(
    j = "% Total",
    border = officer::fp_border(width = 1)
  ) |>

  flextable::fontsize(size = 10, part = "all") |>
  flextable::autofit()

age_ft
```

```{r third tab}
#| title: "Complications IPD"
#| fig.asp: 1
#| out.width: 100%
#| fig.align: center
#| fig.margin: 0

# ---- Any complication (at least one) ----

complications_ipd <- ipd %>%
  dplyr::select(
    starts_with("complications_"),
    -complications_none
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(
    everything(),
    ~ .x %in% c(TRUE, "TRUE", "true")
  ))


any_complication_n <- ipd |>
  dplyr::select(
    starts_with("complications_"),
    -complications_none
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(across(everything(), ~ .x %in% c(TRUE, "TRUE", "true"))) |>
  rowSums(na.rm = TRUE) |>
  (\(x) sum(x > 0))()

complication_prop <- complications_ipd %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), ~ sum(.x, na.rm = TRUE))) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = everything(),
    names_to = "complication",
    values_to = "n"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    complication = stringr::str_remove(complication, "^complications_"),
    pct = round(n / N_IPD * 100, 2)
  )


# ---- Total complications for denominator ----
total_complications <- sum(complication_prop$n)

# ---- Build Section 4 table ----
complications_section4 <- tibble::tibble(
  `Complication Type` = c(
    "Any complication",
    str_to_title(complication_prop$complication)
  ),

  `N (IPD)` = c(
    any_complication_n,
    complication_prop$n
  ),

  Denominator = c(
    N_IPD,
    rep(N_IPD, nrow(complication_prop))
  ),

  `% of IPD` = c(
    round(any_complication_n / N_IPD * 100, 2),
    round(complication_prop$n / N_IPD * 100, 2)
  ),

  `% of Compl.` = c(
    100,
    round(complication_prop$n / total_complications * 100, 2)
  ),

  Notes = NA_character_
)

complication_ft <- flextable::flextable(complications_section4) |>

  flextable::set_header_labels(
    `Complication Type` = "Complication Type",
    `N (IPD)`           = "IPD (N)",
    Denominator         = "Denominator",
    `% of IPD`          = "% of IPD",
    `% of Compl.`       = "% of Compl."
  ) |>

  # Header
  flextable::bold(part = "header") |>
  flextable::align(align = "center", part = "header") |>

  # Body alignment
  flextable::align(
    j = c("N (IPD)", "Denominator", "% of IPD", "% of Compl."),
    align = "center",
    part = "body"
  ) |>

  flextable::align(
    j = "Complication Type",
    align = "left",
    part = "body"
  ) |>

  # Emphasise Any complication
  flextable::bold(
    i = complications_section4$`Complication Type` == "Any complication",
    part = "body"
  ) |>

  flextable::fontsize(size = 10, part = "all") |>
  flextable::autofit()

complication_ft
```
